atomic_step.outcome: The publisher preserves already-staged exact paths and stages only remaining manifest paths.
atomic_step.practical_value: A pending merge containing staged retirements can reach commit without weakening exact-scope or mutation checks.
atomic_step.stopping_condition: Mixed staged and unstaged manifest paths pass, while verification mutation remains blocked.

approaches.hypothesis: Git can safely re-add every selected path.
approaches.implementation: Run git add over the complete manifest.
approaches.predicted_tradeoff: Simple but rejects a deletion already absent from the index.

approaches.hypothesis: Already-staged exact paths should be preserved while only missing index changes are added.
approaches.implementation: Subtract staged paths from the manifest before git add, then validate the complete staged set.
approaches.predicted_tradeoff: One deterministic staged-set read before adding remaining paths.

mini_probes.goal: Stage a mixed manifest without re-adding paths already staged as deletions.

proof.failure_criterion: The merge deletion is re-added or the mutation guard is weakened.
